selection_source_review: Frozen runner fits each full336 forest using x[train],y[train], saves its importances, selects128 by importance/index, then fits128 on same train indices. Validation labels enter reported metrics only. Full336 selector is reused as the336 comparator.
limitations: Consumed development cohort; numerical differences do not establish independent superiority or generalization.
Independent replay verifies saved predictions and metrics; no extra forests were fit and estimator inference was not independently reproduced.
Exact vector collision grouping is conservative and does not assert semantic equivalence.
Selection is fold-specific; these files do not define a single deployable128-column model.
One predeclared seed; no uncertainty or calibrated safety claim.
